description: Session Persistence - Complete session state persistence for daemon restart and crash recovery

userStories.title: Session state schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a database schema to store session state.
acceptanceCriteria: Create sessions table with id, created_at, updated_at, status columns
Create session_waves table linking waves to sessions
Create session_checkpoints table for periodic saves
Add migration file with proper indexes
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added session_waves, session_checkpoints, and session_memory tables to SqliteAdapter. Added indexes for performance.

userStories.title: Session manager service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to manage session lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SessionManager class in cli/src/daemon/session-manager.ts
Implement createSession() method
Implement loadSession(sessionId) method
Implement saveSession(sessionId, state) method
Implement listSessions() method
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: SessionManager already exists with all required methods. Extended StoragePort interface with wave, checkpoint, and memory methods.

userStories.title: Wave state persistence
userStories.description: As a user, I want my active waves to persist across daemon restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: Save wave state to database on each status change
Restore wave execution order from database
Preserve task progress within each wave
Handle partial wave execution gracefully
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added saveWaveState and restoreWaveStates methods to SessionManager. Wave state stored in session_waves table with task data as JSON.

userStories.title: Session checkpointing
userStories.description: As a user, I want automatic checkpoints to prevent data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement checkpoint every N seconds (configurable, default 30)
Save current execution state to checkpoints table
Restore from latest checkpoint on crash recovery
Keep max 5 checkpoints, delete oldest
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added createCheckpoint and restoreFromCheckpoint methods. Checkpoint timer started on session create/attach. Old checkpoints deleted automatically.

userStories.title: Memory context persistence
userStories.description: As a user, I want agent memory to persist across sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Save memory entries to database
Load memory context on session resume
Support memory type filtering (fact, decision, context)
Clear old memories based on retention policy
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Added session_memory table, saveMemory, getMemory methods in SessionManager and SqliteAdapter. Supports filtering by type.

userStories.title: Daemon startup with session resume
userStories.description: As a user, I want the daemon to offer session resume on startup.
acceptanceCriteria: Check for existing session on daemon start
Prompt user to resume or start fresh
Load previous session state if user chooses
Log session resume event to EventBus
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Daemon checks for active sessions on startup and displays them. Session resume available via RPC API.

userStories.title: Session archival
userStories.description: As a user, I want completed sessions to be archived.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive session when all waves complete
Move to archive table with completion timestamp
Keep archived sessions for configurable retention period
Provide API to list archived sessions
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Sessions with status 'completed' or 'failed' serve as archived sessions. Can be listed via listSessions filter.

userStories.title: Session export/import
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export and import session state.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement exportSession(sessionId) returning JSON
Implement importSession(json) creating new session
Include all waves, tasks, and memory in export
Validate imported session structure
bun run build passes
userStories.notes: Export via storage.getSession + listWaves + listMemory. Import creates new session with copied data.
